name: ChampHarbinger
description: Discovery, multi-provider enrichment, intent signals and prospect qualification — the SENSE stage. Previously read-only from the orchestrator: a DAG could read qualified prospects but could not create any.

actions.label: Get Qualified Prospects
actions.description: The 'who to contact today' feed: score + talking points + signal reasoning.

actions.label: Get Signals
actions.description: SENSE-step read-back: detected signals for a prospect/domain, feeding the prospect_lifecycle state machine (e.g. a new signal on a Researched prospect justifies InCadence). Filters the qualified-prospects feed client-side by domain — Harbinger's API has no per-prospect signal endpoint.

actions.label: Acknowledge Prospect
actions.description: Mark a queued prospect ingested (default) or failed. Empty body is valid.

actions.label: Run Signal
actions.description: Fire a signal recipe against a domain. pricing-changes is coded end-to-end; detector tools (rss, jobs, github, wayback, searxng) are registered on main.

actions.label: Import Companies
actions.description: 1-click push of {name, domain} rows into a new campaign.

actions.label: Discover Companies
actions.description: Find companies matching a query and land them in a campaign. Paginates properly and reports whether results are live or mock — a fixture-backed result now carries mock:true rather than silently passing as real.

actions.label: Enrich Company
actions.description: Enrich one company record — industry, size, location, tech signals.

actions.label: Enrich Contact
actions.description: Enrich one person — title, seniority, verified email.

actions.label: Enrich (Waterfall)
actions.description: Run the multi-provider enrichment waterfall, falling through providers until a field resolves. Costs more per record than a single provider but materially lifts fill rate — use for a target list you intend to actually contact.

actions.label: Enrich (Batch)
actions.description: Enrich many records in one call. The efficient path for a freshly imported list.
